items.question: Within how many days of the beginning of each calendar month must employers transfer basic subscriptions into the investment fund under the UAE Savings Scheme for end-of-service benefits?
items.gold: Within 15 days of the beginning of each calendar month.
items.fact: Savings Scheme subscriptions due within 15 days monthly

items.question: Under the UAE Labour Law end-of-service gratuity for expatriate private-sector full-time workers, how many days' salary is paid for each year of work when service is more than 1 year but less than 5 years?
items.gold: 21 days' salary for each year of work.
items.fact: Gratuity for 1-5 years service is 21 days' salary
